title: Delayed homomorphic reinforcement learning for environments with delayed feedback
abstract: arXiv:2604.03641v3 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Reinforcement learning in real-world systems often involves delayed feedback, which violates the Markov assumption and impedes both learning and control. Canonical augmentation-based approaches address this issue by augmenting the state with action histories, but suffer from state-space explosion and the resulting sample-complexity burden. Despite recent progress, state-of-the-art augmentation-based methods either primarily alleviate this burden for the critic or employ separate mechanisms for the actor and critic. To address this limitation, we propose delayed homomorphic reinforcement learning (DHRL), a framework grounded in MDP homomorphisms that introduces a belief-equivalence relation over the augmented state space to collapse control-redundant augmented states into a compact abstract state space. translated_title: 面向延迟反馈环境的延迟同态强化学习
translated_abstract: 现实世界系统中的强化学习常常涉及延迟反馈，这违背了马尔可夫假设，同时阻碍了学习与控制。经典的基于增广的方法通过将动作历史并入状态来解决这一问题，但会遭受状态空间爆炸以及由此带来的样本复杂度负担。尽管近期已有进展，但最先进的基于增广的方法要么主要仅为评论家缓解这一负担，要么对执行者和评论家采用相互分离的机制。为解决这一局限，我们提出了延迟同态强化学习（DHRL），这是一个基于MDP同态的框架，它在增广状态空间上引入信念等价关系，将控制冗余的增广状态折叠成一个紧凑的抽象状态空间。该框架在确定性动态下能够产生精确抽象，在随机动态下能够产生近似抽象。
tldr: 提出基于MDP同态的延迟同态强化学习（DHRL）框架，通过在增广状态空间上引入信念等价关系，将控制冗余的增广状态折叠为紧凑的抽象状态空间，从而解决延迟反馈强化学习中的状态空间爆炸与样本复杂度问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes Delayed Homomorphic Reinforcement Learning (DHRL), an MDP-homomorphism-based framework that introduces a belief-equivalence relation over the augmented state space to collapse control-redundant states into a compact abstract state space, mitigating state-space explosion in reinforcement learning with delayed feedback.
